title: Training-Free Looped Transformers
author: Lizhang Chen; Jonathan Li; Chen Liang; Ni Lao; Qiang Liu
summary: Looped transformers add recurrence by tying layers during training, making looping impossible for models not trained this way. This paper introduces a method to apply looping to existing pretrained models without retraining or changing their architecture. Their approach enables new capabilities for released language models using a simple wrapper.
